subject: rbind a list of matrix/integer objects using ldply

messages.author: ddc1fc70af730460
messages.subject: rbind a list of matrix/integer objects using ldply
parts:
Dear list,

I'm trying to rbind together a list containing matrix AND integer (or
numeric) elements. Those elements are subsets from the slot of a more
complex object. They always has two columns. When there is only 1
sample in the subset, however, an integer is added to the list instead
of a matrix object. Here is a dummy example:

library(plyr)

a <- matrix(runif(4), ncol=2, dimnames=list(as.character(1:2), c('foo','bar')))
b <- runif(2)
names(b) <- c('foo','bar')
d <- matrix(runif(8), ncol=2, dimnames=list(as.character(2:5), c('foo','bar')))
e <- runif(2)
names(e) <- c('foo','bar')

lst <- list(a=a, b=b, d=d, e=e)

I tried to use ldply to rbind them together:

ldply(lst, rbind.data.frame)

But it adds some extra columns:

> ldply(lst, rbind.data.frame)
.id foo bar X0.664468485862017 X0.409359728218988
1 a 0.34412418 0.67829789 NA NA
2 a 0.01570732 0.33235688 NA NA
3 b NA NA 0.6644685 0.4093597
4 d 0.94749119 0.05011662 NA NA
5 d 0.50018870 0.56567157 NA NA
6 d 0.33064570 0.32892335 NA NA
7 d 0.60625531 0.30657005 NA NA
8 e NA NA NA NA
X0.125926561886445 X0.819577906746417
1 NA NA
2 NA NA
3 NA NA
4 NA NA
5 NA NA
6 NA NA
7 NA NA
8 0.1259266 0.8195779

Any pointers?

Cheers,

Pierre
--
Scientist
Landcare Research, New Zealand
